title: After a reset the second factor is still asked
assertion: A reset ends every session of the account and signs it out at the provider (a provider sign-out failure is logged and does not fail the reset), records `password_reset_completed`, keeps the lock, the authenticator and the keys, and lands on the sign-in page with the email filled and a notice focused once, written only now (never for a locked or disabled account, whose notice names the support address); the next sign-in with the new password asks for the code, and the old password is refused
noFileReason: A synthetic persona of its own resets its password and signs in again through the local identity provider; no file.
